OUR TRANSFORMATIVE APPROACH
We are unleashing the potential based on protein engineering technology.

About Us

Creative BioMart is an award-winning biotechnology company that provides the most comprehensive protein engineering-related service portfolio for the biotechnology industry, from library construction to antibody engineering, including large-scale expression and crystallization.

Learn More

THE WORLD'S LEADING PROTEIN ENGINEERING PLATFORM
We're specialists in life science research, pharmaceutical research and biotechnology.

Protein Engineering Platform

Our protein engineering platform is based on gene recombination technology, combined with the research of protein chemistry, protein crystallography and protein dynamics, to design and modify the genes encoding proteins purposefully.

It is our responsibility to meet your protein design needs efficiently and accurately. Customized services can provide professional solutions for customers in multiple fields.

Learn More

Our
Services

Directed Evolution

Directed evolution is an effective means to improve protein function and activity, mainly in the laboratory to simulate natural evolution of protein engineering methods. The steps are mainly repeated gene mutation, selection and amplification. Creative BioMart provides a variety of services based on protein directed evolution strategies to accelerate your project, including the construction and screening of mutation libraries, gene amplification, successful protein engineering from utilizing directed evolution, etc.

Rational Design

Rational design refers to the design based on the comprehensive structural and functional information of the target protein. The use of computer modeling for sequence-based protein design and structure-based protein design has been rapidly developed. Creative BioMart provides a variety of services based on protein rational design strategies to accelerate your project, including protein structure prediction and evaluation, knowledge-based secondary structure self-assembly design, computational design of therapeutic proteins, in-silico pharmacology, etc.

Protein Modification

An important area of protein engineering research is the identification of those post-translationally modified proteins and their modification sites, and the determination of the modified functions and the interactions of the modified proteins in cellular functional networks. Creative BioMart provides a variety of protein post-translational modifications to increase the functional diversity of the proteome, including phosphorylation, glycosylation, nitrosation, methylation, sulfonation, acetylation, hydroxylation, carbonylation and ubiquitination modification, etc.

Protein Synthesis

Synthesis of target proteins according to different properties is of great significance for the exploration and application of proteins in biotechnology and medicine. Starting with gene synthesis and codon optimization, Creative BioMart uses various protein expression systems, purification techniques, and renaturation techniques to solve practical problems encountered in protein synthesis. Based on our experienced team, we ensure that we can synthesize proteins close to the natural structure.

Our
Services

Directed Evolution

Directed evolution is an effective means to improve protein function and activity, mainly in the laboratory to simulate natural evolution of protein engineering methods. The steps are mainly repeated gene mutation, selection and amplification. Creative BioMart provides a variety of services based on protein directed evolution strategies to accelerate your project, including the construction and screening of mutation libraries, gene amplification, successful protein engineering from utilizing directed evolution, etc.

Rational Design

Rational design refers to the design based on the comprehensive structural and functional information of the target protein. The use of computer modeling for sequence-based protein design and structure-based protein design has been rapidly developed. Creative BioMart provides a variety of services based on protein rational design strategies to accelerate your project, including protein structure prediction and evaluation, knowledge-based secondary structure self-assembly design, computational design of therapeutic proteins, in-silico pharmacology, etc.

Protein Modification

An important area of protein engineering research is the identification of those post-translationally modified proteins and their modification sites, and the determination of the modified functions and the interactions of the modified proteins in cellular functional networks. Creative BioMart provides a variety of protein post-translational modifications to increase the functional diversity of the proteome, including phosphorylation, glycosylation, nitrosation, methylation, sulfonation, acetylation, hydroxylation, carbonylation and ubiquitination modification, etc.

Protein Synthesis

Synthesis of target proteins according to different properties is of great significance for the exploration and application of proteins in biotechnology and medicine. Starting with gene synthesis and codon optimization, Creative BioMart uses various protein expression systems, purification techniques, and renaturation techniques to solve practical problems encountered in protein synthesis. Based on our experienced team, we ensure that we can synthesize proteins close to the natural structure.

accelerate their journey to success.

What We Do

Protein is a substance closely related to life and various forms of life activities. Every cell and

encoding a certain protein, so that the synthesized protein becomes more in line with human needs.
With years of accumulated experience, Creative BioMart has established a strong scientific team and
a fully integrated platform for protein engineering, providing one-stop services and customizable
solutions to fully meet the specific requirements of customers.

## Sanjay Gala

[][36]
Sanjay Gala, Founder and CEO of SMARTe, has spent more than 20 years solving one of the most
persistent go-to-market challenges: poor data quality. He built SMARTe into a Gartner- and
Forrester-recognized platform trusted by more than 100 enterprises across 200+ countries, helping
B2B revenue teams move from guesswork to precise targeting, compliant outreach, and measurable
pipeline growth.

A serial entrepreneur and bootstrap veteran, Sanjay was also the Co-Founder of Zycus Inc., another
data-driven software company. He holds an MBA from Golden Gate University and an MS in Electrical
Engineering from Oregon State University, where his thesis focused on implementing neural network
algorithms using semiconductor chips. He is also the holder of three U.S. patents.

Outside of work, Sanjay enjoys hiking, marathon running, singing, and spending time with extended
family and friends. He is also passionate about career coaching, using his network and 35 years of
global experience to help others grow professionally.

## Frequently Asked Questions

#### What is one credit?

A credit is a standard unit that equals one successful data operation across our platform. Whether
you're discovering prospects, enriching contacts, revealing contact details, or using our API, each
successful request costs one credit.

#### How does the Free License work?

New users can get 10 credits per month to discover SMARTe at no cost, no obligation, and no credit
card needed. Your free license allows you to explore the data platform for an unlimited period.

#### Does SMARTe integrate with my CRM?

SMARTe integrates with HubSpot, Salesforce, Outreach, and SalesLoft. We’re constantly working on
adding more integrations. Contact us for any requests.

#### Is SMARTe's Data GDPR aligned and CCPA compliant?

Yes, our data is fully committed and aligned with the GDPR & CCPA requirements.

#### What is the difference between price plans?

Each plan offers a different number of credits and features, depending on your company’s needs.

#### Does SMARTe provides multi-year discounts?

Yes, to know more about multi-year discounts [book a demo.][39]

#### I have more questions. Where can I find answers?

We'd love to help. You can contact us at our email - [contactus@smarte.pro][40] or give us a call at

[Market Sizing and Forecasting]

## Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

[Read More about Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis][49]
[Competitive intelligence illustration showing business analytics]

## Customer, Channel and Use Case Insights

Our Customer, Channel & Use Case Insights reveal what drives adoption, loyalty, and value creation.
We analyse customer behaviours, channel economics, and real-world use cases to identify the
segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

Granular understanding of how customers discover, select, purchase and use products and services
across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions
actually drive choice.

[Read More about Customer, Channel and Use Case Insights][50]
[Trend research illustration showing forecasting and data analysis]

## Thematic and Disruption Research

Our Thematic & Disruption Research identifies the structural shifts, emerging technologies, new
business models, and macro forces reshaping industries. We decode early signals, model long-term
scenarios, and highlight opportunities and risks-equipping leaders with future-ready insight to
guide strategy, investment, innovation, and organizational resilience.

Deep dives on cross-cutting themes such as sustainability, digital transformation, AI, automation,
circular economy and new revenue models. We connect these themes back to specific industry and
segment opportunities.

[Read More about Thematic and Disruption Research][51]
[Thematic and Disruption Research]

## Strategic Revenue Advisory

Our Strategic Revenue Advisory helps organizations make confident, evidence-driven decisions about
where to focus, how to grow, and which capabilities matter most. We integrate market insight,
customer behaviour, competitive context, and financial modelling to build a revenue strategy that is
resilient, high-impact, and aligned with long-term growth opportunities.

Support for decisions on where to play, how to win and how fast to move. This includes portfolio
focus, market entry, pricing, partnership strategy and capital allocation grounded in evidence.

[Read More about Strategic Revenue Advisory][52]
[Strategic Revenue Advisory]

## Deliverables That Drive Revenue Decisions

Research outputs designed to plug directly into planning, investment and board level discussions.

### From Insight to Implementation

#### Data Collection

Structured gathering of market, customer, financial and competitive data from primary and secondary
sources.

#### Analytics and Modelling

Use of quantitative models and AI supported analysis to reveal patterns, stress points and leading
indicators.

#### Insight Development

Senior analysts translate findings into clear storylines and strategic implications.

#### Actionable Deliverables

Concrete recommendations, prioritised actions and quantified impact ranges.

#### Follow Through and Measurement

Support in defining KPIs and tracking how decisions influence revenue, margin and risk over time.

## Your Trusted Partner in Market and Revenue Intelligence

Strategic Revenue Insights is part of SRI Consulting Group Ltd and focuses on one thing: helping
organisations make better revenue decisions.

### Informed Strategic Planning

We give strategy, finance and business leaders a common, fact-based view of the markets they operate
in. This reduces debate about “what is true” and shifts the conversation to “what should we do
next”.

### Stronger Investment and Portfolio Choices

By linking market outlooks to product, geography and customer portfolios, we help you decide where
to expand, where to hold and where to exit. The result is sharper focus and better use of capital.

### Faster, More Confident Execution

Clear evidence and simple narratives make it easier to align leadership teams

Its core offerings include AI-powered solutions for clinical trial searches, drug pipeline tracking, regulatory monitoring, and automated research reporting, all designed to support clinical researchers, pharmaceutical companies, and research institutions. With a focus on comprehensive insights and real-time updates, Trial enhances the efficiency and effectiveness of drug development processes.

What data sources does MedPath Trial use?
MedPath Trial aggregates data from ClinicalTrials.gov, WHO ICTRP, EudraCT, and 12+ regulatory agencies including FDA, EMA, NMPA, TGA, and Health Canada. All data is updated daily. How does the AI research assistant work?
Our AI analyzes trial protocols, regulatory documents, and scientific literature to provide insights. All AI-generated content includes source citations for verification. Is the data on MedPath Trial free to access?
Basic search and trial information is free. Pro and Team plans unlock advanced features like AI research, data export, and priority support. How often is the data updated?
Clinical trial data is updated daily from primary registries. Regulatory approval data is updated as announcements are made. News is aggregated in real-time.

In 2005, Y Combinator developed a new model of startup funding. Four times a year we invest $500k in
a select group of startups. They move to San Francisco for three months, where we work intensively
with them to get the company into the best possible shape, before they present to a large audience
of investors on Demo Day.

But YC doesn’t end on Demo Day. We and the YC alumni network continue to help founders for the life
of their company, and beyond.

[Founder][Founder][Founder][Founder][Founder]

## In Founders’ Words

YC compresses months of growth into weeks.[Aman Mishra]The sense of urgency is so infectious among
founders that it becomes the most productive period in most people’s lives.[Adith Reddi]
It’s a community of founders that you can’t find anywhere else.[Bishesh Khadka]It feels like having
the entire world at your back—from Partners to batchmates.[Justin Lee]
Being surrounded by the top 1% of founders in the world just completely resets the bar.[Fern
Morrison]You leave with a completely new sense of how fast ‘fast’ can be.[Aman Mishra]

In 2005, Y Combinator developed a new model of startup funding. Four times a year we invest $500k in
a select group of startups. They move to San Francisco for three months, where we work intensively
with them to get the company into the best possible shape, before they present to a large audience
of investors on Demo Day.

But YC doesn’t end on Demo Day. We and the YC alumni network continue to help founders for the life
of their company, and beyond.

talk about the newest tech and how it could change the world. In this episode, they discuss
contrarian bets — the ideas that look impossible until they work. From Uber and Coinbase to DoorDash
and Flock Safety, they share how founders find opportunity where others see dead ends.
